methodology.source_authority: Source and tests, not comments/index summaries. No builds, tests, service calls, installations, or credentials used.

methodology.json_wire_rules: Go encoding/json: []byte is base64; omit only according to field tags; nil slices/maps without omitempty are null; empty allocated slices are []; pointers preserve absence vs explicit false/zero; unknown object fields tolerated by decodeJSON; decoder reads first value without EOF check. Preserve time.Time JSON RFC3339 nanosecond precision and string timestamps as implemented.
methodology.important_wire_exception: Go time.Time struct fields are not omitted by omitempty at zero value (e.g. filesSaveResp.mtime). Preserve this explicitly in goldens.
methodology.dynamic_path_semantics: Prefix routes preserve net/http.ServeMux slash redirects and exact handler Trim/Split behavior; malformed-prefix auth errors are not normalized. Every proposed Rust fixture identifier is pending, not an executed test.
methodology.source_text_policy: Bodies are referenced by exact baseline file/line/symbol and SHA-256; read the source rather than duplicating it.
